setup.title: Wine Map
setup.subtitle: No poses. Just wine.
setup.description: Drag each denomination onto its region. Learn the map of Italian wine, one card at a time.

game.dragInstruction: Drag to the correct region on the map

profile.emptySubtitle: Complete your first session to see your statistics.

autoPlace.title: Maximum attempts reached
autoPlace.subtitle: The correct answer has been revealed.

quiz.emptySubtitle: There aren't enough questions loaded to make a paper. Come back once the bank has been filled.
quiz.unavailableSubtitle: Couldn't reach the cellar to draw you a paper. Nothing is lost — try again in a moment.

start.title: Would you pass right now?
start.subtitle: One sitting, {count} questions, the whole course. The tannin marks it and tells you straight.

rules.length: {count} questions, one per screen. Go back and change your mind as often as you like.
rules.levels: All three levels in one paper, exactly like the real thing.
rules.passMark: Pass at {pct}%. Blanks count as wrong, so guess rather than skip.
rules.timer: The clock is shown but never stops you. This is study, not an ambush.

start.composition: {open} written answers, {multipleChoice} multiple choice, {trueFalse} true or false. The written ones you type yourself, and the tannin reads every word.

resume.title: You left a paper open
resume.progress: {answered} of {total} answered. Nothing was lost — it waits as long as you need.
resume.abandon: Bin it and start a new one

warn.title: Bin the whole paper?
warn.body: {count, plural, =0 {It's untouched, so there's nothing to mourn. Gone for good, though.} one {# answer goes in the bin with it, for good.} other {# answers go in the bin with it, for good.}}

exam.notFoundSubtitle: This paper isn't yours or no longer exists. Start a fresh one.
exam.openPlaceholder: Write your answer. Your own words are fine — the point is what you know, not how you phrase it.

review.title: Before you hand it in
review.allAnswered: Every question answered. Nothing left on the table.
review.blanks: {count, plural, one {# question left blank} other {# questions left blank}} — every one of them counts as wrong.
review.jumpHint: Tap a number to go back to it.

warn.title: Handing in with blanks?
warn.body: {count, plural, one {# question is} other {# questions are}} still empty. They will be marked wrong. Sure?

result.gradingBody: The multiple choice is done — it's below. The written ones take a moment longer, because somebody actually has to read them.
result.gradingStalledBody: Some of your written answers didn't get marked. Nothing was counted wrong for it and your paper is untouched — ask again and it picks up where it stopped.
result.passedSubtitle: You'd have walked out of that room with the certificate. Do it again next week and it stops being luck.
result.failedSubtitle: Not today. The good news is you now know exactly which questions cost you the pass.
